event_summary.short: Shoplifter Kayla was trespassed from a store in Kent, Washington. She threw buckets in anger and was arrested for disorderly conduct and resisting arrest. Officers also found drugs and paraphernalia but did not charge due to a new city ordinance. She was eventually charged with tampering with property and resisting.
